subject: Renewal: Zenith - new payor + PO allocation (capacity + add-on)
messages:
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
To: Marta Lopez <marta.lopez@zenith.ai>, Procurement Team <procurement@zenith.ai>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>

Subject: Renewal: Zenith - new payor + PO allocation (capacity + add-on)

Hi Marta / Procurement,

Thanks again for the conversation yesterday — great to have Zenith committed for the 12‑month renewal plus the capacity add‑on (30% uplift). A few billing items we need to lock before contracting and invoice issuance so finance can process cleanly:

1) Legal payor mapping: you mentioned the US parent will cover the base commit and the EU subsidiary will be charged for the add‑on. Please confirm the exact invoice payor names and billing addresses for each legal entity.

2) PO numbers: we need a PO for the base commit and a separate PO for the add‑on (so our invoices can be routed to the correct payor). If you can share PO numbers and the associated legal entity, we’ll map them in our system.

3) Tax forms & payment method: for the US payor we’ll need a W‑9. For the EU payor we need VAT/EORI details to include on the invoice. Also let us know if we should expect ACH/EFT — if yes, we can send an EFT instruction form.

4) Net terms: current renewal proposal assumes Net30. If Procurement requires Net45/Net60, flag it now so we can include it in the amendment.

Attached: quote (summary of base + add‑on) and the proposed renewal amendment with split‑invoice language.

Next step: If you can reply with the two PO numbers and the payor legal names by EOD Tue 8/3, we’ll prepare two invoices (proforma if needed) and route the amendment for signature.

Thanks — Hannah

--
Hannah Schmitt
Account Executive, Renewals
Redwood Inference
hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai

Subject: Re: Renewal: Zenith - new payor + PO allocation (capacity + add-on)

Hi Hannah — thanks for the clear note. Confirming initial details:

• Base commit (US parent) will go on PO #ZEN-44521 — payor: Zenith Analytics, Inc. (US) — billing address: 1200 Harbor Blvd, Suite 700, San Diego, CA 92101, EIN 27-1234567.
• Add‑on (EU subsidiary) will be on PO #ZEN-44577 — payor: Zenith Analytics Europe B.V. — billing address: Keizersgracht 482, 1017 EK Amsterdam, Netherlands.

We will attach the signed PO (PO_44521_zenith.pdf) for the US item. We still need your W‑9 and EFT instructions to complete vendor setup. For the EU side we’re pulling the VAT/EORI from legal and will share by next Tue 8/3.

Regarding net terms — procurement prefers to stay Net30 for both invoices if possible. If there’s any internal constraint on Redwood’s side (billing two separate legal entities), let us know.

Best,
Marta

Hi Marta — appreciate the fast turnaround and PO.

I’ve attached our completed W‑9 (W9_Redwood_Inc.pdf) and a short vendor EFT form. A couple of notes from finance to make sure invoices process without a delay:

• Invoice entity names and remit addresses must exactly match the payor names on the POs. Please confirm the spelling for the EU entity once you have legal’s VAT/EORI.
• Because the add‑on will bill the EU subsidiary in EUR, we’ll issue that invoice with the EU VAT number on it. If the EU entity wants the invoice routed to a parent node for treasury, flag the redirect contact now.
• We can issue proforma invoices for AP to trigger payment if you prefer — say the draft amounts and we’ll mark them proforma.

Attached for your review: W9_Redwood_Inc.pdf, vendor_eft_instructions.pdf, and an internal invoice mapping sheet. If everything looks right I’ll ask billing to create two invoice profiles (ZEN-44521 => US profile; ZEN-44577 => EU profile) and queue the proformas.

Thanks,
Neha
